plain: Loud and noisy in demanding something.

webster.text: Speaking and repeating loud words; noisy; vociferous; loud; turbulent.

example.quote: Sir, if I do not stand on the bottom of integrity, and pure love for Virginia, as much as those who can be most clamorous, I wish '"o resign my existence.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
